title: Reminders: a switch to a record with a higher erase epoch during the permission ask is refused like an erase; the switch stays off with no words
evidence: From the owner's review of PR 1594. ios/HealthRoadmap/Reminders/ReminderMode.swift asking x asked turns reminders on only when the epoch read before the ask (or the last good read) is at least the one read after the grant. A switch between phone and cloud records to one with a higher epoch looks the same as an erase, so the grant is refused, the same as on(0) x read(2) today. Fails safe. Owner ruling on PR 1608: no words for the user; it stays off with no words and the next tap after a good read turns reminders on, so no words a person reads change and it needs no ruling from Brad. US-25 AC12b
